issues.where: crop 2 and crop 3, the right-hand leaf pair at the stem joint (a bead at the leaf base) and the underside of the left leaf in crop 2 (a dark round bead near its notched edge)
issues.what: water droplets sit on the leaves although this part of the film has no water, frost or dew; the bead on the left leaf reads as a dark hole or ring rather than a lit drop
issues.fix: remove the droplets from the leaves in this section, or if dew is wanted, make them consistent across the plant and lit with a highlight and refraction

issues.where: the large lower leaf left of the stem, bottom centre of the frame (about x 570-790, y 610-788)
issues.what: its whole outline carries a thin dotted bright fringe that reads as a cut-out halo or matte edge rather than hairs; the face is a flat, evenly shaded card with soft blotchy patches and no visible thickness at the folded top edge
issues.fix: remove the outline fringe or replace it with sparse, varied backlit hairs; give the leaf a real curl, edge thickness and vein relief

issues.where: crop 4, both edges of the main stem
issues.what: the stem hairs form a continuous, evenly bright white rim of near-identical spikes down both sides, much brighter than any other backlit part; it reads as an outline glow or halo rather than individual hairs catching light
issues.fix: vary hair length, density and angle, dim the rim so brightness falls off with angle to the light, and let some hairs go dark

issues.where: crop 6, the mountain ridge on the right half of the skyline
issues.what: the ridge is a flat, solid black silhouette with a jagged stamped profile and no atmospheric depth or texture; it reads as a flat cut-out picture behind the field
issues.fix: add aerial perspective, slight tonal variation and ridge detail, and soften the edge to suit the distance

issues.where: crop 5, the fog band between the field and the mountains on the left
issues.what: the mist is an even horizontal layer with a fairly hard top edge that sits on the picture rather than winding through the terrain
issues.fix: break up the fog density and top edge and let it thin and wrap round the land forms

issues.where: crop 2, the lit upper face of the left leaf
issues.what: zoomed past native size, the blistered surface shows stair-stepped, slightly pixelated edges along the ridges and a waxy, pale-green sheen
issues.fix: raise texture resolution, add antialiasing on fine relief, and lower the specular so the leaf reads less waxy

issues.where: crops 5 and 6, the out-of-focus foliage in the dark field
issues.what: the defocused leaves carry grainy noise and a few small bright blotches that read as render noise rather than bokeh
issues.fix: denoise the out-of-focus field and keep only highlights the lighting would actually make
